entries.description: Authored spec.md (3-session plan: GroupLevel source fix + ModuleName in Session 1, integration test in Session 2, docs update in Session 3). Authored ai-assignment.md via route(task_type=analysis). Key pre-session finding: AccessTextParser produces 'GroupLevel 0' (space-separated) child nodes for GroupLevel configuration, not flat Properties keys — current extractor reads wrong source.

Rewrote ReportMetadataExtractor.BuildGroupLevels: replaced flat-Properties GroupLevel<N> key approach with scan of 'GroupLevel N' (space-separated) child nodes for per-level metadata (GroupOnCol->GroupOn, GroupOn code->GroupingMode, SortOrder, KeepTogether, GroupInterval). Added GroupLevelConfigRegex. Added decoding tables for GroupingMode (0=EachValue..9=Interval), SortOrder (0=Ascending, 1=Descending), KeepTogether (0=None, 1=WholeGroup, 2=WithFirstDetail). Config nodes filtered out of meta.Children (code-review finding: they bled into Children alongside design-band sections). Removed consumedGroupLevelKeys. Updated GroupLevel tests to use 'GroupLevel 0' child nodes; added decoding tests for all codes; added config-node-exclusion test.

Added AccessObjectReader.ReadModuleName: scans first 10 lines of VbaCode for Attribute VB_Name = '...' line, returns quoted value or null. Wired into FormMetadataExtractor and ReportMetadataExtractor. Replaced deferred-null ModuleName tests with extraction tests (VB_Name present, absent, VbaCode absent) in both test files.
dotnet build clean (0 errors). dotnet test AccessHarvester.Tests: 436 active passing, 2 SkippableFact skipped. No regressions.

Routed code review (sonnet, complexity_hint=55). ISSUES_FOUND: 1 real bug — GroupLevel config nodes bled into meta.Children; fixed by filtering Type-matching GroupLevelConfigRegex nodes before assigning Children. Minor: added 10-line comment to ReadModuleName. Verifier (gemini-pro): VERIFIED.
Cross-provider session verification routed to gpt-5-4. VERIFIED on first round. Raw output saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.
